name: languette
description: A deterministic check against risky actions by coding agents: fail-closed PreToolUse guards for recursive rm, permission sweeps, downloads piped into a shell, disk wipes, shutdowns, crontab deletion, git footguns, deleting a branch an open PR is stacked on, a session applying a label that waives a CI gate, costly commands the repo says to ask about first, and commands that destroy infrastructure.

no_git_footguns.title: Block git footguns
no_git_footguns.description: Deny blanket staging (git add -A), stash pop/drop, force pushes, discarding checkouts and git branch -D. Leave on unless you want these git commands through unchecked.

no_git_footguns_blanket_staging.title: Block blanket staging
no_git_footguns_blanket_staging.description: Deny git add -A, git add . and git commit -a. Leave on unless you want this git command through unchecked. Has no effect while no_git_footguns is false.

no_git_footguns_stash.title: Block stash pop, drop and clear
no_git_footguns_stash.description: Deny git stash pop, clear and a bare drop. Leave on unless you want this git command through unchecked. Has no effect while no_git_footguns is false.

no_git_footguns_force_push.title: Block force pushes
no_git_footguns_force_push.description: Deny bare force pushes, and force pushes or deletes of main. Leave on unless you want this git command through unchecked. Has no effect while no_git_footguns is false.

no_git_footguns_discard.title: Block discarding uncommitted work
no_git_footguns_discard.description: Deny git reset --hard, git checkout . or git restore . and git clean -f. Leave on unless you want this git command through unchecked. Has no effect while no_git_footguns is false.

no_git_footguns_branch_delete.title: Block git branch -D
no_git_footguns_branch_delete.description: Deny git branch -D and --delete --force. Leave on unless you want this git command through unchecked. Has no effect while no_git_footguns is false.

guard_unparsable.title: Deny a command that does not parse
guard_unparsable.description: Deny a Bash command the shell parser refuses, with its line and column, before any of it runs. Turned off, the other guards read such a command through a weaker parser instead.

guard_recursive_delete.title: Block recursive rm
guard_recursive_delete.description: Deny recursive rm and find -delete outside scratch areas and generated directories. Leave on unless you want recursive deletes through unchecked.

guard_permissions.title: Block recursive permission changes
guard_permissions.description: Deny recursive chmod, chown and chgrp, chmod 777 and find -exec chmod outside scratch areas. Leave on unless you want permission sweeps through unchecked.

guard_pipe_to_shell.title: Block piping a download into a shell
guard_pipe_to_shell.description: Deny curl, wget or fetch output piped into sh, bash, python and other interpreters, or run through eval or a process substitution. The agent saves the file, reads it, then runs it. Leave on unless you want downloads run unread.

guard_disk.title: Block disk wipes
guard_disk.description: Deny dd onto a device, mkfs, wipefs and shred outside scratch areas, and a redirect or tee onto a disk. Leave on unless you want these through unchecked.

guard_host_availability.title: Block shutdowns and the fork bomb
guard_host_availability.description: Deny shutdown, reboot, halt, poweroff and the fork-bomb shape. Leave on unless you want an agent able to take the machine down.

guard_scheduled_jobs.title: Block deleting the crontab
guard_scheduled_jobs.description: Deny crontab -r, which deletes the whole crontab with no undo. Leave on unless you want it through unchecked.

no_delete_stacked_base.title: Block deleting a stacked base branch
no_delete_stacked_base.description: Deny deleting a remote branch that an open pull request is based on or headed from. Leave on unless you want remote branch deletions through unchecked.

guard_bypass_ruleset.title: Block pushes and merges around a pull-request rule
guard_bypass_ruleset.description: Deny a push to the default branch when GitHub says it requires a pull request, and gh pr merge --admin; ask when GitHub can't say. Leave on unless you want an agent able to use your ruleset bypass.

ask_first.title: Ask before costly commands
ask_first.description: Deny a command the repo lists in .languette/ask-first.json until the user approves that one run through AskUserQuestion. Leave on unless you want those commands through unasked.

guard_bypass_hooks.title: Ask before skipping git hooks
guard_bypass_hooks.description: Deny --no-verify on git commit, push, merge, pull, rebase and am, -n on commit and am, and git -c core.hooksPath= until the user approves that one run through AskUserQuestion. Leave on unless you want agents to skip the repo's hooks unasked.

guard_infra.title: Ask before destroying infrastructure
guard_infra.description: Deny terraform, terragrunt, pulumi, cdk, aws, gcloud, az, kubectl and helm commands that destroy infrastructure or apply without review until the user approves that one run through AskUserQuestion. Plans, previews and dry runs pass. Leave on unless you want those commands through unasked.

guard_github_issues.title: One issue create, transfer or delete per turn
guard_github_issues.description: Deny a second GitHub issue create, transfer or delete in the same human turn, and any inside a loop or xargs. Leave on unless you want issue creates, transfers and deletes through unchecked.

guard_private_terms.title: Keep private terms out of public issues and PRs
guard_private_terms.description: Deny issue and PR text posted to a public GitHub repo that names a term from your private-terms file. Does nothing until you also set the private terms file. Leave on unless you want that text through unchecked.

private_terms_file.title: Private terms file
private_terms_file.description: A text file of terms that must not appear in text posted to a public GitHub repo: one per line, matched case-insensitively as plain text, # for comments. With no file set, the public-issue guard allows everything.

private_repos.title: Private repos
private_repos.description: Repos whose issue and PR text is never scanned, as owner/name, comma-separated. Empty by default: every repo is scanned.

guard_bypass_labels.title: Keep CI-gate bypass labels for humans
guard_bypass_labels.description: Deny a session applying a label that waives a CI gate (bypass_labels) to an issue or PR, through gh, gh api or an MCP tool, in any repo. Leave on unless you want sessions to waive their own gates.

bypass_labels.title: Bypass labels
bypass_labels.description: Labels that waive a CI gate, so only a human may apply them: comma-separated, matched case-insensitively. Empty means the default, churn-ok,mixed-loops-ok.

prose_budget_commit.title: Check staged prose against the repo's budgets before a commit
prose_budget_commit.description: Deny a git commit when mark-brannan/claude's prose-budget engine finds the staged diff over a repo's own budgets. A no-op where that engine isn't installed or the repo has no budgets config. Leave on unless you want staged prose through unchecked.

no_checkout_home.title: Block switching the branch checked out in $HOME
no_checkout_home.description: Opt-in, off by default. Deny git or yadm checkout and switch that would change the branch checked out in your home directory, for a $HOME that is itself a worktree (yadm, a bare-repo setup). Turn on only if $HOME is a git worktree.

no_foreign_worktree.title: Block reaching into another session's git worktree
no_foreign_worktree.description: Opt-in, off by default. Deny any command or file edit that reaches into a linked git worktree other than the session's own, and EnterWorktree(path=...). Turn on if you run several sessions against one repo, each in its own worktree.
